artifacts.apply_sync marker-before-launcher order and the refused logic

summary: Launcher-only repositories. aicore.project.artifacts: plan_marker/plan_sync(marker=...)/apply_sync write .swissknifeman/project.json (workspace, project_id, plans_store) atomically before the launcher; an existing marker with other values, an invalid marker or a symlink is refused (PROJECT_MARKER_CONFLICT etc.) and nothing is written. aicore.project.cli: init takes --project CODE [--workspace CODE] [--plans-store workspace|legacy] (workspace defaults to the selected one, store to legacy when plans/ holds plan folders, else workspace); without --project init is as before (launcher + lock). New aicore.project.migrate and `project migrate [--dry-run] [--json]` move config.toml, state/, backups/, stubs/ of the checkout's .swissknifeman/ into projects/<code>/local/ (never overwrites: identical files dropped, different ones are PROJECT_MIGRATE_CONFLICT, symlinks PROJECT_MIGRATE_SYMLINK, no workspace project folder PROJECT_LOCAL_UNAVAILABLE; idempotent, under the project sync lock). `project doctor` gets project.local (local/ folder, config against project-local-config/v1, repo.path against the checkout) and project.checkout-layer (warn on leftovers). Tests: new LauncherOnlyTests in test_project_cli.py (31 tests in the file OK); also OK: aicore test_cli, test_usage, test_workspace, config.test_project_local, test_contracts, test_schema, test_architecture, test_python39, state.test_locations, state.test_backups, test_stubs, test_localconfig; ecosystem-units check exit 0 (all run with PYTHONPATH=lib AICORE_ROOT=packages/aicore).
